# Veloxra, LLC

> AI-accelerated Managed Service Provider (MSP) and cleared IT operations firm serving federal, defense, intelligence, state, and local agencies across the Washington, D.C. Metropolitan Area (DMV: Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia).

## Entity & Procurement Identifiers
- **Legal Name:** Veloxra, LLC
- **Jurisdiction:** Commonwealth of Virginia
- **Business Size:** Small Business (For-Profit LLC)
- **UEI:** [UEI_PENDING_SAM_VALIDATION]
- **CAGE Code:** [CAGE_PENDING_DLA]
- **Primary NAICS:** 541513 (Computer Facilities Management Services), 541512 (Computer Systems Design Services), 541519 (Other Computer Related Services), 811210 (Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance)
- **Federal Payment Systems:** SAM.gov EFT, DoD PIEE / WAWF, Treasury IPP, Government Purchase Card (GPC Level 2/3)

## Core Services
- **Managed IT Services (MSP):** 24/7 monitoring, patch management, Tier 1–3 service desk augmentation, Zero Trust endpoint hardening.
- **Cloud & Network Engineering:** Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, hybrid infrastructure, LAN/WAN switching/routing, NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 1 alignment.
- **Software & Application Support:** Application sustainment, QA, workflow automation, SOP engineering.
- **On-Site Hardware Refresh & Field Ops:** Rapid DMV-wide hardware replacement, component/motherboard swaps, workstation imaging, and cleared field dispatch.
